description: The raster database estimates United States levee protection standards using the method in an associated Water Resources Research paper. This resource is provided by Gang Zhao. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists TIF formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Estimated standards are model-derived and do not replace certified design or operating standards. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
